intent: A person can search the Catalog with one Han character, which is a complete word, while one Latin letter, digit or symbol is still too little to search.
observable_outcome: GET /api/skills/search?q=表 searches; q=R, q=1 and q=! are still refused or answered as not searchable.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A query of one Han character, including one outside the basic block such as 𠮟, is searchable.
A query of one Latin letter, digit, kana or symbol is not searchable.
